text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — were scheduling the v1.2 announcement and webinar. Need final changelog link + docs up by Tue 6pm PT so we can rehearse slides Wed 8am PT. Can eng confirm rollout windows?

Jamie (Eng): We can. Are we doing a daytime canary or overnight? Also want to know if marketing needs any safety copy for rollback messaging.

Priya (Product): Daytime canary. Plan: 10% for 1.5h, 30% for 4h, 100% after 18h if metrics stable. Regions: NA -> EU -> APAC with 3h observation gaps. Rollback wording: "We temporarily paused the rollout to investigate a quality regression" good enough for public docs.

Tom (Docs): I'll draft release notes + migration steps. Draft link: https://redwood.example.com/docs/releases/v1.2-draft (please don't share). Will export a short changelog snippet for the blog.

Maya (Marketing): Need a 10-word headline, two-sentence intro, and the exact changelog bullets. Also webinar slide text + CTA link.

Jamie (Eng): Changelog bullets for marketing (kept short):
```
- adaptive batching (beta): avg token cost ~20% lower on chat flows
- KV-cache improvements: tighter p95 latency and fewer cache misses
- routing: canary + fallback when model variant mismatch occurs
```

Tom (Docs): Included those in the draft release notes and added a troubleshooting FAQ. Will add a "what to expect" section for customers upgrading.

Sana (Growth Ops): For inbound routing: well tag webinar signups with launch_webinar_2026 and set UTM utm_campaign=redwood-v1.2-webinar. SDR flow ID: crm-flow-9932.

Maya (Marketing): Embargo? Well hold media outreach until Wednesday 10am PT. Please don't circulate pre-embargo materials externally.

Priya (Product): One ask: auto-fallback trigger if eval-quality drops >1.5% over 20 minutes. Wire to both rollback and an ops page alert.

Jamie (Eng): Will add automated policy to the runbook and tie alerts to #eng-oncall and @ml-evals. Runbook snippet: 
```
policy: staged-by-region
steps:
  - region: na, pct: 10
  - wait: 90m
  - region: na,eu, pct: 30
  - wait: 240m
  - region: all, pct: 100
monitor: [latency_p95, error_rate, eval_quality]
rollback: eval_quality_drop>1.5% for 20m -> fallback to previous_model_variant
```

Jamie (Eng): Runbook posted: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/launch-v1.2 (ops-only).

Maya (Marketing): Tom, once docs are live please paste the public changelog link here. Well need it in the blog and webinar registration.

Tom (Docs): Public notes live: https://redwood.example.com/docs/releases/v1.2 — includes changelog, upgrade steps, and FAQ. Ping me if wording needs to be punchier.

Sana (Growth Ops): SDR routing configured: https://internal.redwood/crm/flows/crm-flow-9932 adds tag + utm + routes to SDRs (team: growth-sdr).

deploy-bot: Deploy queued for Wed 10:15 PT (canary window). Job id: job-6062-2201. Will post status here.

Maya (Marketing): Draft post copy (first pass):
"Redwood Inference v1.2: adaptive batching + KV cache upgrades to cut costs and tighten latency tails. Join our live webinar to see savings and Q&A."

Priya (Product): Nice. Suggest adding a short data point: "saves ~20% token cost on common chat workloads" in the webinar slide.

Maya (Marketing): Added. Final checklist recap:
- Tue 6pm PT: docs + changelog public (Tom)
- Wed 8am PT: marketing rehearsal (Maya + Priya)
- Wed 9am PT: webinar invites go out (Maya)
- Wed 10:15 PT: start canary (Eng)
- Wed 10:30 PT: publish public blog + open webinar signup (Marketing)
- Post-publish: SDR routing + press outreach (Sana, after embargo lifts)

Jamie (Eng): All set from infra side. Will monitor p50/p95, error rate, and eval metrics. Will escalate if rollback thresholds hit.

Tom (Docs): Done on docs. Link: https://redwood.example.com/docs/releases/v1.2 (public).

Sana (Growth Ops): Embargo lifted at 10:30 PT per plan. Ill trigger press list then.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team. Ill post the blog draft in this thread by EOD for a quick sign-off. :rocket:
